name: listStations
description: Gets a paginated, filtered, and sorted list of stations. Corresponds to GET /api/stations/v1/stations. Requires `stations:read` scope. [READ-ONLY]

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields: id, name, lastModified.at, created.at. Prefix with - for descending.

filter.description: Only stations in one station group: stationGroupId eq '<id>' (or eq null for ungrouped). Only the eq operator is supported.

archived.description: List archived items instead of active ones.
